note: Five sites strung along 0.8 mile of Fire Tower Road, 3.0 to 3.8 miles along it, under closed canopy, each with a picnic table and fire ring; the agency classes them for small trailers. Wallowing Hole, Bushkill and Lost Camp are short gravel back-ins beside the road. Half Mile is a grass pull-in, soft after rain. Fire Tower is a small pad, listed at 25 by 30 ft, at the end of a 300-ft drive. Fire Tower Road is a forest road reached from US 6 just west of Milford by 0.7 mile of Schocopee Road. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
